body.text: SEO Services is what businesses look for when they want their website to appear at the top of Google for terms their customers actually search. Not one-time tweaks or vanity metrics, but a continuous, structured program of technical health, keyword-aligned content, and authoritative signals that compound month after month.

Teknoppy delivers SEO services that connect directly to business outcomes — qualified inquiries, direct bookings, and organic revenue. Since 2018, we have helped businesses in Kerala, across India, and in international markets build and protect Page-1 positions in competitive search verticals.

sections.h2: What Great SEO Services Actually Include

paragraphs.text: SEO is not a single task — it is a discipline that connects your website's code, structure, content, and reputation. A credible SEO services provider works across four foundational pillars: technical SEO, on-page optimization, content and keyword strategy, and off-page authority building.

Skip any one of these pillars and the rest underperforms. A fast site with thin content will not rank; brilliant content with crawl errors will never be indexed; and great content on an unindexed domain has no audience. Our SEO services address all four together.

Search in 2026 is no longer just ten blue links. Google AI Overviews, generative answer engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude), and voice search all pull from the same underlying foundation: authoritative, structured, and fast-loading web content.

SEO services today are not just about ranking for human searchers; they are about becoming the trusted source that AI answer engines cite when answering questions in your industry. That requires schema markup, clear entity relationships, and genuine topic depth.

items.a: A complete engagement covers technical SEO, on-page optimization, content and keyword strategy, local SEO (where relevant), schema markup, and monthly performance reporting. Teknoppy addresses all of these together so no single pillar is neglected.

items.q: How much do SEO services cost?
items.a: Most businesses invest between Rs. 15,000 and Rs. 75,000 per month depending on competition, scope, and target markets. Enterprise and large-scale ecommerce programs range higher. We provide a written quote before any engagement begins.

items.q: How long do SEO services take to show results?
items.a: Most clients see meaningful movement within 3 to 6 months, with gains compounding significantly over 12 months. Timelines depend on current domain authority, competitive density, and how quickly recommendations are implemented.

items.q: How to choose an SEO services company?
items.a: Look for written scope, transparent reporting, real case studies, and a team that explains their approach in plain English. Avoid providers who promise guaranteed #1 rankings or use opaque, proprietary techniques.

items.q: What is the difference between SEO services and SEO consulting?
items.a: SEO services mean we execute the work directly — audits, fixes, content, links. SEO consulting means we advise your in-house team on what to build and fix, reviewing their work and guiding strategy.

items.q: Which is the best SEO services provider for my business?
items.a: The right fit depends on your industry, budget, and current site health — a best-in-class provider should have verifiable case studies in similar verticals, transparent reporting, and deep technical capabilities.

items.q: Do SEO services also help with AI answer engines like ChatGPT and Perplexity?
items.a: Yes. Alongside traditional Google rankings, we structure content and schema for answer engines (AEO and GEO), making your business the authoritative source AI models cite when users ask relevant questions.

items.q: Do you offer SEO services for businesses outside Kerala or India?
items.a: Yes. While Teknoppy is based in Kerala, our SEO services are delivered remotely for clients across India, the GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar), and international markets worldwide.
